definitions.gloss: claw crane game; claw machine; UFO catcher
definitions.explanation: An arcade game where players use a joystick to maneuver a mechanical claw to grab prizes such as stuffed animals, figures, or snacks. A staple of Japanese game centers.

examples.japanese: クレーンゲーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ぬいぐるみ→ぬいぐるみ：05289_nuigurumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I won a stuffed animal from the claw machine.

examples.japanese: クレーンゲーム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up spending a thousand yen on the claw machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲームセンター→ゲームセンター：27104_geemusentaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧クレーンゲーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦フィギュア→フィギュア：07081_figyua⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}って→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}した→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: I tried many times to get a limited-edition figure from the claw machine at the game center.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Extremely popular in Japan, where game centers (⟦ゲームセンター→ゲームセンター：27104_geemusentaa⟧) often dedicate entire floors to claw machines. The brand name UFOキャッチャー (UFO Catcher, by SEGA) is often used as a generic term. Prizes range from plush toys to high-end figures, snacks, and even electronics. Staff can sometimes reposition prizes if a customer has spent enough.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クレーンゲーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧ (to play the claw machine)
- クレーンゲーム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景品|けいひん}→景品：08319_keihin⟧ (claw machine prizes)
- クレーンゲーム⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧ (to try the claw machine)

WRITING:
Also called UFOキャッチャー (brand name) or simply クレゲー in casual speech.
